message.content:
This editorial illustration presents a vertical rectangular magazine cover with a background composed of several vertical, multicolored bars reminiscent of a television test pattern. These bars are, from left to right: red, yellow, light blue, green, purple, red, and blue. At the bottom, a horizontal strip of multicolored squares completes the test pattern aesthetic.

The word "TEMPO" is written in large, yellow, capital letters across the top. Below this, the date "20-26 JANUARI 2014" appears in small white text. The main headline, "SIASAT POLITIK STASIUN TELEVISI," is rendered in large, white, sans-serif, capital letters, layered over the vertical bars. Beneath this, a smaller yellow block of text reads, "Permainan di balik seleksi anggota Komisi Penyiaran Indonesia."

Portions of three human faces are visible, positioned as if peering from behind the background elements. On the far left, part of a face with glasses is visible. On the right, the right half of a bearded man's face is visible. Near the bottom center, the upper half of a clean-shaven man's face is visible.

At the top, white text reads "MARZUKI ALIE DAN SUAP HAMBALANG." The bottom left corner contains pricing and publication information, including a barcode and the text "RP 33.000," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126-4273."
